meta.purpose: Relative pedestrian presence over Seoul, to decide where shared kick-scooters and e-bikes must be dense. Not a device count. Open data only (OSM buildings, no NGII).
meta.unit: Index: the mean over all listed cells is 1.0 for every layer. A cell not listed has weight 0 (no OSM building inside Seoul). Share of Seoul = w / (cells listed).

grid.cellId: row * cols + col (cells listed first in each array)
grid.projection: x = (lon - west) * metersPerDegree * cos(37.55 deg), y = (lat - south) * metersPerDegree; same as jigak-backend return-rules.ts / parking-rules.ts
grid.to500m: a 500 m cell (aligned to the same origin) is the mean of its listed 250 m children (divide by the number of listed children, not 4)

layers.weDay: weekend (Sat 2026-06-13 and Sun 2026-06-14 mean), hours 08-19 mean
layers.res: weekday 03-05h mean: residents asleep (where people live); 0 station term

sources.use: 행정동 code -> name, to match the OSM 행정동 polygons

sources.name: OpenStreetMap (Geofabrik south-korea-latest extract, as used for OSRM)
sources.use: buildings (footprint, building:levels, building=*), 행정동/자치구/서울 boundaries, 주민센터 points

sources.name: 수도권 도시철도 역 좌표 (jigak-backend/src/modules/places/data/place-stations-v1.json)
sources.use: station coordinates for the kernel and hot-cell names

steps: 1. Each 행정동 hourly 생활인구 P(d, slot) is split into a resident part min(P, base) and a visitor part max(P - base, 0), base = P at 03-05h (res layer).
2. A building belongs to the OSM 행정동 polygon (admin_level=8) that holds its centroid, matched to the 생활인구 code by 자치구 and name; buildings outside Seoul (admin_level=4) are dropped.
3. The resident part goes to buildings by residential floor area and the visitor part by activity floor area (class weights below); a 행정동 without one kind uses the other.
4. Floor area = footprint x min(building:levels, 30); a building without building:levels takes the default of its building=* type (below). Roofs, greenhouses, construction sites and sheds weigh 0.
5. Mass is summed per 250 m cell and normalised to share (pop term).
6. Station term: Gaussian kernel sigma 200 m around each station with weight = mean daily (boardings + alightings); share-normalised.
7. w = 0.8 * pop term + 0.2 * station term (res: pop term only), kept on cells with an OSM building inside Seoul and scaled to mean 1 over them.

limits: OSM maps fewer Seoul buildings than the national 1:1,000 map (about half the footprint area), mostly small low-rise houses: inside a 행정동 its people go to the buildings OSM has, and a block with no mapped building weighs 0. Totals per 행정동 are kept.
building:levels is tagged on a minority of buildings; the rest use the type defaults (가정값).
OSM 행정동 boundaries can lag 생활인구 codes; unmatched polygons and codes are listed in method.assignment.
생활인구 counts people present (LTE signal), not walkers; station term adds pass-through flow. Both are proxies for PM demand, not PM trips.
Rivers, hills and parks carry no buildings and so 0 weight; riverside parks (한강공원) are not hot in this layer.
Weekday/weekend and day/night come from one week in June; November use needs the 0.79 season factor on volume, not on shape (shape not re-measured).

blend.trip ends: demand_cell = rent_ttareungi_cell * (1 - b) + b * N_trips * wShare_cell (see assumptions.ts foot).
blend.rebalancing target / placement: target_cell = N_rentable * w^gamma / sum(w^gamma) (see assumptions.ts foot).
